I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands, herebydeclare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose andwill be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in total extent of about 0.0661Hectare depicted as Lot A in the Plan No. GAM/MAHA/2014/402dated 28.11.2014 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys- Gampaha District, situated in the village called Gongitota in theGrama Niladhari Division No. 255 C of Gongitota in Adikari PattuwaMinor Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mahara inGampaha District of Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Delgahawaththa – Extent: About 0.0661 HectareNorth: Land name not known and the claimant could not be traced;East: Land name not known and claimed by B. K. Piyasena;South:Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
